text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: 2026-03-12 21:00Z — p99 latency breach detected for model `gpt-redwood-fp8-v2` (us-west-2). Streaming stalls and increased tail seen across multiple routes. Paging @maria @tj :rotating_light:

maria: acked, on call. pulling up traces + recent deploys.

maria: quick snapshot from metrics (last 30m):
```
route: /v1/generate (model=gpt-redwood-fp8-v2)
p50  60ms
p95  420ms -> baseline ~120ms
p99  2.8s -> spike up from 350ms
stream stalls ratio: 1.9% -> baseline 0.1%
error 5xx rate: 0.6%
```

tj: thanks. any config changes in the last 6 hours?

maria: yes — we rolled a new fp8 calibration profile at 2026-03-12T14:12Z. config id `fp8-calib-v3`. It replaced `fp8-calib-v2` as part of the throughput improvement rollout.

emi: FYI I saw increased kv-cache misses around the same time; KV cache hit rate dropped ~7 percentage points.

maria: suspect calibration changed per-token decode timing and increased KV contention leading to stalls.

tj: ok let's try two mitigations in parallel: 1) rollback quant profile to `fp8-calib-v2` for this model, 2) temporarily divert traffic for high-latency customers to `gpt-redwood-fp8-v1` (non-calibrated) until rollback stabilizes.

naveen: I can take the traffic diversion. maria / tj — do you want me to run the redirect?

maria: please. i'll initiate the rollback now. command we use: 
```bash
# internal control plane CLI
redwoodctl models set-quant --model gpt-redwood-fp8-v2 --quant-profile fp8-calib-v2 --reason "rollout-induced tail latency"
```

opsbot: STARTING: model update job id=job_20260312_2115 (initiated by maria)
opsbot: rolling update to nodes=us-west-2-gpupool-3 (gradual, 30s drain)

maria: rolling back. watching deploy logs.

maria: deploy logs snippet: 
```
[2116:12] node-12: pulling model artifact
[2116:20] node-12: applying quant profile fp8-calib-v2
[2116:28] node-12: healthcheck passed
[2116:40] node-12: join serving pool
...
```

tj: while that's happening, naveen can you add a temporary route rule for these customers: `acme-co`, `finlytics` — move to `gpt-redwood-fp8-v1` for reads that require streaming. keep write path normal.

naveen: doing. patching route table: 
```json
{ "route": "/v1/stream", "match": {"customer_id": ["acme-co","finlytics"]}, "target_model": "gpt-redwood-fp8-v1", "ttl": 1800 }
```

opsbot: ROUTE UPDATE: success (route_patch_8734) — diverted for acme-co, finlytics.

maria: rollback finished across 90% nodes. sampling traces again.

maria: updated metrics (5m after rollback):
```
p50  58ms
p95  130ms
p99  360ms
stream stalls ratio: 0.12%
error 5xx rate: 0.12%
```

tj: much better. looks like `fp8-calib-v3` introduced a calibration path that interacts poorly with our KV-chunking; rollback improves tail.

emi: I captured a flamegraph — increased time in `dequantize()` in v3 for certain layer sizes. attaching snippet: 
```
# hot path v3
- dequantize (22%)
- attention_kv_merge (18%)
- kv_cache_lock_wait (15%)
```

maria: good catch. we should block fp8-calib-v3 until we validate the dequant path. I've opened a follow-up ticket: INF-8472.

tj: customer impact: acme-co reported a few streaming stalls and began switching to fallback themselves; we saw ~4% request retries for them. finlytics saw degraded p99 but no errors. I'll prepare a customer incident note.

maria: quick summary for handoff to next oncall (naveen):
- incident: p99 spike + streaming stalls after `fp8-calib-v3` rollout
- mitigation done: rolled back to `fp8-calib-v2`, diverted two affected customers to `gpt-redwood-fp8-v1` for streaming, KV cache warmed, monitored for 30m
- current status: stable, metrics back to baseline, no active paging
- follow-ups: INF-8472 (root cause dequant interaction), QA validation for next quant profile, add pre-rollout KV-load test to rollout pipeline

naveen: taking the handoff. i'll keep an eye for 2 more hours and coordinate with ML for repro. would like an action item: add an automated smoke test that runs a small KV-heavy stream workload post-quant-rollout.

opsbot: NOTE: incident resolved (stable) — monitoring for 2h post-rollback. incident-bot will trigger if p99 > 1s again.

maria: thanks everyone. tagging for visibility: @emi (ml), @tj (infra), @naveen (oncall).

tj: i'll also revert rollout gating to require KV-heavy synthetic tests before allowing `fp8` profile promotions.

maria: closing thread, moving to postmortem. :white_check_mark:

(reacts: :thumbsup: from tj, :eyes: from emi)
